title_zh: 如何高效地剪vlog？又被我学到了哈哈！
title_en: How to Edit Vlogs Efficiently? I Just Learned a Trick!

scenes.scene_zh: 开场：10个单子有8个都是vlog，节假日后接单现状。刚好刚剪完一条vlog，分享最近剪vlog的心得。
scenes.scene_en: Opening: 8 out of 10 orders are vlogs—that's the reality after the holidays. I just finished editing one, so here are my latest insights.
scenes.context: 自由职业剪辑师的vlog剪辑经验分享。
sentences: 10个单子有8个单子都是vlog，这就是节假日后接单的现状。
8 out of 10 orders are vlogs—that's the reality after the holidays.
Vlogs are everywhere.
跟大家说一下我最近剪vlog的一些小心得。
Let me share some of my recent tips for editing vlogs.
Practical experience.

scenes.scene_zh: 传统方法：把素材按时间顺序铺进时间轴，全部无素材快速浏览，然后听文案分段，不断把画面对上文案。
scenes.scene_en: The old way: drop all clips onto the timeline in order, quickly skim everything, then split the voiceover by sentences and keep matching footage to the script.
scenes.context: 铺满时间轴再对文案，是很多人的默认流程。
sentences: 把素材按照排好的时间顺序，直接导入进时间轴里。
Import the clips into the timeline in sorted chronological order.
The classic starting point.
然后快速的去预览整个素材，然后再去听文案用这段剪口播。
Then quickly preview everything, and listen to the script to cut the talking head.
Skim first, then match.
之后就是不断的把画面对上这个文案就可以了。
After that, just keep matching the footage to the script.
Simple in theory.

scenes.scene_zh: 问题：素材铺得太长，对文案时突然反应不过来素材铺到哪去了，得来回找素材位置，非常浪费时间。
scenes.scene_en: The problem: with a long timeline, you lose track of where you are when matching the script, and you keep hunting back and forth for clips—hugely inefficient.
scenes.context: 长时间轴导致定位困难，来回拖拽浪费时间。
sentences: 但是我就发现一个问题，非常浪费效率。
But I found one problem—it's terribly inefficient.
The pain point.
你不断的在往后铺素材，铺得太长了，对文案时突然反应不过来。
You keep extending the timeline so far that you lose your place when matching the script.
Losing track of position.
还得来回来回的去找这个素材的位置。
You end up searching back and forth for clip positions.
The endless hunt.

scenes.scene_zh: 新思路：拿到素材先分成两大类——主体人物类和其它类（非主体人物、空景、补充镜头）。
scenes.scene_en: The new approach: sort the footage into two categories first—main-subject shots and everything else (secondary people, empty scenes, filler shots).
scenes.context: 先分类再剪辑，让思路清晰。
sentences: 拿到素材之后，直接把整个素材归为两个大类。
Once you get the footage, sort it all into two big categories.
Two buckets, that's it.
一个是主体人物类，一个就是其他类。
One is main-subject shots, the other is everything else.
Main subject vs. support.
其他类就包括了非主体人物，以及空景，还有一些补充镜头。
Everything else includes secondary people, empty scenes, and filler shots.
Support footage.

scenes.scene_zh: 先导入主体镜头按时间排序，音频上需要补充画面时再导入非主体素材，整个思路非常清晰。
scenes.scene_en: Import the main-subject shots first in order, then bring in the supporting footage only when the audio needs extra visuals—everything stays clear in your head.
scenes.context: 主体先行，补充按需，思路清晰。
sentences: 先导入主体镜头，然后把这些都按照时间顺序去排序。
Import the main-subject shots first and arrange them in chronological order.
Build the spine first.
在音频上有需要补充画面的时候，再去导入这些非主体素材。
Then bring in the supporting footage only when the audio needs extra visuals.
Add support on demand.
这样子的话，你的整个脑子的思路是非常清晰的。
This way, the whole process stays very clear in your head.
Clarity is the win.

scenes.scene_zh: 邪门方法：先剪好文案录音，铺一张素材的底，拉到录音末尾，然后一句话一句话或一个场景一个场景把素材切开替换。
scenes.scene_en: The sneaky trick: cut the voiceover first, lay down one placeholder clip spanning the whole recording, then cut and swap in real footage sentence by sentence or scene by scene.
scenes.context: 以录音为骨架，素材随切随换。
sentences: 先把整个的文案录音给剪了。
First, cut the entire voiceover recording.
The audio is the skeleton.
它是直接铺了一张素材的底，然后拉到这个录音的末尾。
It lays down one placeholder clip stretched to the end of the recording.
One long placeholder.
根据这一句话一句话，或者一个场景一个场景，把这个素材分别切开。
Then cut the placeholder sentence by sentence or scene by scene.
Cut on the beats.
然后拿vlog的素材不断的去替换掉每一段。
Then keep swapping in real vlog footage for each segment.
Swap, not search.

scenes.scene_zh: 这个方法适合自己非常了解素材的情况，尤其剪自己的vlog，事半功倍，完全不用想，直接切直接换。
scenes.scene_en: This works best when you know your footage well, especially your own vlogs—it's twice the result with half the effort, no thinking needed, just cut and swap.
sentences: 这个方法真的是非常适用于你自己对素材非常了解的情况下。
This method really works when you know your footage very well.
Know your footage first.
尤其是剪自己的vlog的时候，就真的是事半功倍。
Especially for your own vlogs—it's twice the result with half the effort.
Perfect for personal vlogs.
你完全不需要想，直接嘎嘎嘎就切就换，就非常快。
You don't even need to think—just cut and swap, super fast.
Fast and effortless.

scenes.scene_zh: 结尾：大家国庆中秋期间的vlog也可以这样剪，完全是邪门高效。还有更好的方法欢迎分享。
scenes.scene_en: Ending: you can try this on your National Day or Mid-Autumn vlogs—it's gloriously efficient. And feel free to share even better methods.
scenes.context: 鼓励实践并分享更多方法。
sentences: 大家如果是自己国庆中秋期间的vlog，也可以尝试这样剪一下。
If you have vlogs from the holidays, try editing them this way.
Give it a try.
大家还有什么剪vlog的好方法，也可以过来告诉我。
If you have other great vlog-editing methods, come tell me.
Share your tricks.
